title: All-q Levi flag distance scheme, cycle rank, and Hodge primitive idempotent
purpose: Lift the q=3 Levi-flag association/Hodge stack to every generalized quadrangle of order (q,q): identify the flag line graph distance array and shell sizes, derive its spectrum, prove the -2 eigenspace is exactly the Levi cycle space of dimension q^4, derive the radial primitive-idempotent numerator (q^4,-q^3,q^2,-q,1), recover the W33 81-dimensional projector as q=3, and connect this carefully to the published flag association-scheme literature without claiming priority for the underlying symmetric fusion.

targets.5388: symbolic all-q flag line-graph distance and shell theorem
targets.5389: all-q line-graph spectrum and multiplicity theorem
targets.5390: oriented-incidence proof that the -2 eigenspace equals Levi cycle space with dimension q^4
targets.5391: radial primitive idempotent and second-eigenmatrix terminal column
targets.5392: q=3 specialization exactly recovers BT545-BT551 Hodge kernel
targets.5393: literature/prior-art boundary and manuscript theorem insert

boundary: The 4-class flag association scheme for generalized quadrangles is existing literature; do not claim novelty for that fusion or its valencies. The repo contribution is the explicit all-q Hodge/cycle-space identification, q^4 multiplicity, radial projector bridge, and exact specialization to the existing W33 Levi stack. Do not infer a general quantum-code distance or physical protection theorem from the cycle projector alone.
